title: Taking Maximum Energy From the Mystic Dungeon
summary: In a mystical dungeon, there are n magicians arranged in a line.
statement: In a mystical dungeon, there are n magicians arranged in a line. Each magician provides an energy attribute, which can be positive or negative. After absorbing energy from magician i, you teleport to magician (i + k) and repeat the process until you cannot move further. Given an array of energy values and an integer k, determine the maximum total energy you can gain by following this teleporting and absorbing process.
constraints: energy is nonempty and may contain positive or negative integers.
Choose any starting index, collect its value, then repeatedly jump exactly k positions right until leaving the array.
Return the maximum total energy over all starting positions.
hints: Routes from indices with the same remainder modulo k form chains, and each route total is a suffix sum of one chain.
Scan right to left and add the already-computed route total k positions ahead.
dp[i]=energy[i]+dp[i+k] when in bounds; return max(dp).
The forced next jump gives the recurrence exactly, and considering every starting index considers every legal route.
editorial: The forced next jump gives the recurrence exactly, and considering every starting index considers every legal route.

tests.explanation: Starting at index two collects -1 and stops, which is better than every other route.
Starting at index one collects 2 then 1, for the maximum total of three.
